blind.description: A stylized fantasy dragon or demon skull resting directly on the ground. It features a long snout, prominent eye sockets and nasal openings, sharp upper teeth lining the jaw, and two large ribbed horns curving backwards and inward from the brow. Green moss or lichen patches are textured around the base of the horns and across the forehead ridge. The model is fully solid and continuous with stylized cartoon-proportioned geometry, painted in weathered ivory bone tones with warm brown shading in recesses and brownish-tan horns.
blind.from_above: A vertically symmetrical skull with two curved horns pointing toward the top, a defined central sagittal crest, and an elongated snout pointing straight down, flanked by moss patches at the horn bases.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 to 3 feet tall), roughly 3 feet wide horn-to-horn, and 4 to 5 feet long from snout to horn tips.

notes: height slightly taller than catalog ratio
